Pat

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: RMSEA 90%-CI
parts:
This may be a bug. Or a failure of the optimization routine to find an
upper bound for the RMSEA CI in this setting. I will try to locate the
source of the problem.

I opened an issue about this is on github (so I don't forget):

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/issues/189

Having said this: I would not recommend using estimator = "WLSM" if you
treat the data as continuous. Better use estimator = "MLM".

Yves.
